description.zh:
数据库账号密码。
- 由大写字母、小写字母、数字、特殊字符中的任意三种组成。
- 特殊符号包含：`!@#$%^&*()_+-=`
- 密码长度为8~32个字符。
description.en:
The password of the database account.

*   The password must contain at least three of the following character types: uppercase letters, lowercase letters, digits, and special characters.
*   Special characters include `! @ # $ % ^ & * ( ) _ + - =`
*   The password must be 8 to 32 characters in length.
The region ID of the instance.

descriptions.zh: 本接口用于重置supabase数据库密码
descriptions.en: Call this API to reset the password of the Supabase database.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun gpdb reset-supabase-project-password --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --account-password Pw123456 --project-id sbp-tyarplz0000 --region cn-hangzhou
